summary: HypoExplorer compares five female PND37 hypothalami with five female PND22 hypothalami. The authors’ code and both deposited DESeq2 result lists confirm 17 contrasts. Their female PND37 comparisons use PND27 or PND32 as baseline, so agreement for the registered contrast remains unassessed. [Author code and results](https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.25517503)
openIssues: Reopen if an author-issued gene-level result identifies the female whole-hypothalamus PND37-versus-PND22 libraries, baseline and effect definition. A selected-gene result would reopen only those genes.
